claim_scope: executed phase (source open + full-text lifecycle); p50/mean/p95 claimed (min-direction 20.55/20.74/22.24 lower, both directions, clean drifts; pre-floor rule); p99 rejected (candidate drift +17.90 over the 15% ceiling)

protocol.processes: one fresh process per A/B/B/A leg; samples within each leg run in-process
protocol.acceptance: a statistic is accepted only when candidate elapsed time is lower in both paired directions and control/candidate same-implementation drift stays within that statistic's threshold
protocol.percentiles: p50 = statistics.median; p95/p99 = nearest-rank (tools/perf_compare.py method); drift = (second_leg - first_leg) / first_leg

binaries.note: control is the banked 0220 binary; candidate adds the 0221 borrowing-reads + depth-gated resolution OpenParse::run change in litchi-odt

provenance.source_state: HEAD 4e94ee7d8 (banked through 0220, both binaries); the candidate additionally carries the 0221 OpenParse::run borrowing-reads change in litchi-odt

timing_scope: filesystem_read_or_path_open_and_unified_document_full_text_query_inside_timer; corpus, temporary-file setup, semantic parity, archive identity, and source replay outside timer
verification: harness-embedded corpus hash identical across legs; in-harness semantic/read-evidence gates passed on every leg (a failed gate aborts the leg with a non-zero exit)
